Polished Crystal and Stone Carvings Lot - 16 Pieces
Assorted Mineral Specimens, Obelisks, Towers, and Decorative Shapes
A versatile 16-piece collection of polished natural mineral specimens and crystal carvings. Featuring an array of popular lapidary materials including agate, quartz, jasper, aventurine, and obsidian, this grouping displays a wide variety of faceted crystal points alongside smooth novelty carvings suited for display, metaphysical collections, or decorative accents.

9 faceted standing crystal obelisk towers, including carnelian agate, white quartz, aventurine, rhodonite, snowflake obsidian, and rainbow aura-coated crystal (measuring up to approx. 4.5 inches tall)

1 natural quartz crystal point specimen (approx. 2.25 inches long)
2 carved stone mushrooms in banded agate and purple stone (measuring up to approx. 2.5 inches tall)
3 carved accent stones: 1 carnelian star, 1 banded agate heart, and 1 red jasper coffin cabochon
Condition:
